logline: Midpoint. Nick's penthouse office on Madison. A fur king and a woman from Eighth Avenue discover they're both locked out of the same bank.

shots.framing: A corner office: windows on Madison, a desk the size of a car, a fox stole on a dress form
shots.blocking: Delphine seated across the desk, ledger on her knee; Nick standing at the window
beats: Two worlds in one frame: let the space sit

shots.blocking: She sets the ledger on the desk and turns it to face him

shots.framing: Over Delphine: Nick reading the columns, impressed despite himself
